description: Seed memories for the AI Opportunity Scout demo. These are fixtures for MCP integration and do not claim live opportunity facts.
safety_notes: Do not persist secrets, credentials, private keys, cookies, or personal access tokens.
Live deadlines, eligibility, regions, and timezone claims must be verified from primary sources before final recommendations.
The ranking memory below captures the demo rubric, not an externally verified live ranking.

memories.canonical_text: User prefers AI hackathons focused on AI Agents, MemoryAgent, persistent agent memory, persistent context, or agent workflow infrastructure.
memories.raw_source: Session 1 demo user statement: I want AI Agent and MemoryAgent hackathons.

memories.canonical_text: When comparing opportunities, user values credential lift, useful network, founder resources, mentor access, and product credibility over prize money alone.
memories.raw_source: Session 1 demo user statement: prioritize credential, network, founder resources, and useful backing.

memories.canonical_text: Before ranking or recommending a hackathon, verify the official deadline, submission timezone, region and eligibility rules, and track fit from primary sources; mark any unverified field as pending rather than confirmed.
memories.raw_source: Session 1 procedure requirement and Session 3 failure reflection.

memories.canonical_text: Previous opportunity scouting failed by recommending an event before checking whether China or Hong Kong participants were eligible. Treat region or eligibility mismatch as a hard disqualifier unless the user explicitly asks for a watchlist item.
memories.raw_source: Session 3 demo correction: this competition is not eligible for China/Hong Kong; do not recommend these again.

memories.canonical_text: For the MVP demo ranking, prioritize Qwen Cloud Track 1 / MemoryAgent as P0 when deadline and eligibility are verified because it directly matches persistent agent memory and Qwen memory reasoning; consider TRAE P1 when it supports developer-agent workflow and network goals; keep CockroachDB P2 or watchlist unless database/backend resources materially improve the current build. Live facts remain verification gates.
memories.raw_source: Session 2 demo decision rubric for comparing Qwen, TRAE, and CockroachDB opportunities.

ranking.name: Qwen Cloud Track 1 / MemoryAgent
ranking.condition: Only after official deadline and eligibility are verified.

ranking.name: TRAE
ranking.condition: If developer-agent workflow fit and user-value signals are verified.

ranking.name: CockroachDB
ranking.condition: Promote only if database/backend resources directly help the current product.
